name: Victoria DiPietro

residences.place: 1009 Bunker Hill Street, Scranton Ward 10, Pennsylvania, USA
residences.note: Mother, 78, widowed, born Italy, alien; living with son John DiBiasi, his wife Effie and sons Dominic, Vito, Nicholas, Victor.

bioAdditions: In April 1940 Victoria, 78 and widowed, still an alien, lived with her son John DiBiasi's family at 1009 Bunker Hill Street (S1). The FamilySearch tree also attaches a 1930 census entry ('Victoria Piazzi') (S2).
